title: Can you solve the temple riddle? - Dennis E. Shasha
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】你能解開寺廟之謎嗎？ - 丹尼斯·E·沙沙（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: You've found the hidden switches, evaded the secret traps, and now your expedition finally stands
cues.en: You've found the hidden switches, evaded the secret traps, and now your expedition finally stands
cues.zh: 你找到了秘密的開關 躲過了隱藏的陷阱 現在你的探險隊總算站在

cues.text: at the heart of the ancient temple inside The Lost City.
cues.en: at the heart of the ancient temple inside The Lost City.
cues.zh: 現在你的探險隊總算站在 「失落之城」裡古神殿的中心

cues.text: But as you study the inscriptions in the near total darkness, two of the eight graduate students accompanying you
cues.en: But as you study the inscriptions in the near total darkness, two of the eight graduate students accompanying you
cues.zh: 「失落之城」裡古神殿的中心 但當你身處幾乎完全黑暗中 解讀銘文時 同行八位研究生中的兩位

cues.text: bump into the alter.
cues.en: bump into the alter.
cues.zh: 碰撞到了祭壇 突然，兩縷綠色煙霧冒了出來

cues.text: Suddenly, two whisps of green smoke burst forth
cues.en: Suddenly, two whisps of green smoke burst forth
cues.zh: 突然，兩縷綠色煙霧冒了出來 牆壁開始震動

cues.text: and the walls begin to shake.
cues.en: and the walls begin to shake.
cues.zh: 突然，兩縷綠色煙霧冒了出來 牆壁開始震動

cues.text: Fleeing for your lives, you come to a room you passed before with five hallways,
cues.en: Fleeing for your lives, you come to a room you passed before with five hallways,
cues.zh: 趕快逃命 你們來到之前經過 有著五條通道的密室 其中一條通往祭壇，一條則可回到外面

cues.text: including the one to the altar and the one leading back outside.
cues.en: including the one to the altar and the one leading back outside.
cues.zh: 其中一條通往祭壇，一條則可回到外面 中央有個巨大的沙漏正在滴漏

cues.text: The giant sandglass in the center is now flowing, with less than an hour before it empties,
cues.en: The giant sandglass in the center is now flowing, with less than an hour before it empties,
cues.zh: 中央有個巨大的沙漏正在滴漏 不到一個小時便會漏盡 隆隆聲響告訴你 在那之前得離開這現場

cues.text: and the rumbling tells you that you don't want to be around when that happens.
cues.en: and the rumbling tells you that you don't want to be around when that happens.
cues.zh: 隆隆聲響告訴你 在那之前得離開這現場 你回憶一下來時之路

cues.text: From what you recall of your way here, it would take about 20 minutes to reach the exit at a fast pace.
cues.en: From what you recall of your way here, it would take about 20 minutes to reach the exit at a fast pace.
cues.zh: 你回憶一下來時之路 最快要花二十分鐘才能抵達出口

cues.text: You know this is the last junction before the exit, but your trail markings have been erased,
cues.en: You know this is the last junction before the exit, but your trail markings have been erased,
cues.zh: 最快要花二十分鐘才能抵達出口 你知道這是出口前的最後一個岔路 但來時的足跡都已被抹掉了 而且沒有人記得正確的路

cues.text: and no one remembers the way.
cues.en: and no one remembers the way.
cues.zh: 而且沒有人記得正確的路 如果你們九個分組

cues.text: If nine of you split up, there should be just enough time for each group to explore one of the four halls ahead and report back to this room,
cues.en: If nine of you split up, there should be just enough time for each group to explore one of the four halls ahead and report back to this room,
cues.zh: 如果你們九個分組 應當有足夠時間 讓每一組各自探索四條通道之一， 然後返回彙報 接著所有人一起從正確的路逃出去

cues.text: with everyone then making a run down the correct path.
cues.en: with everyone then making a run down the correct path.
cues.zh: 接著所有人一起從正確的路逃出去 這裡正好有一個問題

cues.text: There's just one problem; the inscriptions told of the altar's curse:
cues.en: There's just one problem; the inscriptions told of the altar's curse:
cues.zh: 接著所有人一起從正確的路逃出去 這裡正好有一個問題 銘文記載了祭壇的詛咒： 國王和皇后的幽靈 將纏附在侵入者身上

cues.text: the spirits of the city's King and Queen possessing intruders
cues.en: the spirits of the city's King and Queen possessing intruders
cues.zh: 國王和皇后的幽靈 將纏附在侵入者身上

cues.text: and leading them to their doom through deception.
cues.en: and leading them to their doom through deception.
cues.zh: 國王和皇后的幽靈 將纏附在侵入者身上 並透過詭計將他們帶向死亡

cues.text: Remembering the green smoke, you realize two of the students have been cursed.
cues.en: Remembering the green smoke, you realize two of the students have been cursed.
cues.zh: 並透過詭計將他們帶向死亡 你想起了綠色的煙霧 意識到兩個學生已遭到詛咒

cues.text: At any time, one or both of them might lie,
cues.en: At any time, one or both of them might lie,
cues.zh: 意識到兩個學生已遭到詛咒 他們其中一或兩人隨時可能說謊

cues.text: though they also might tell the truth.
cues.en: though they also might tell the truth.
cues.zh: 他們其中一或兩人隨時可能說謊 也可能說實話

cues.text: You know for sure that the curse didn't get you, but you don't know which students can't be trusted,
cues.en: You know for sure that the curse didn't get you, but you don't know which students can't be trusted,
cues.zh: 也可能說實話 你確信自己並沒遭到詛咒 但你不知道哪兩個位學生是無法信任

cues.text: and because the possessed students may lie only occasionally,
cues.en: and because the possessed students may lie only occasionally,
cues.zh: 因為被附身的學生可能只會偶爾說謊

cues.text: there is no guaranteed way to test them to determine which are cursed.
cues.en: there is no guaranteed way to test them to determine which are cursed.
cues.zh: 因此並不能保證能夠測試出誰被詛咒了

cues.text: Can you figure out a way to ensure that you all escape?
cues.en: Can you figure out a way to ensure that you all escape?
cues.zh: 你能想出方法讓你們全都脫困嗎？ 不必擔心遭附身的學生攻擊

cues.text: Don't worry about the possessed students attacking or otherwise harming the others.
cues.en: Don't worry about the possessed students attacking or otherwise harming the others.
cues.zh: 不必擔心遭附身的學生攻擊 或者傷害別人

cues.text: This curse only affects their communication.
cues.en: This curse only affects their communication.
cues.zh: 或者傷害別人 這詛咒僅會影響他們的溝通而已

cues.text: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out by yourself!
cues.en: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out by yourself!
cues.zh: 這詛咒僅會影響他們的溝通而已 現在請暫停影片， 如果你想自己找出方法的話

cues.text: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.en: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.zh: 公佈答案：3 公佈答案：2 公佈答案：1

cues.text: The first thing to realize is that since you know you aren't possessed, you can explore one of the halls alone.
cues.en: The first thing to realize is that since you know you aren't possessed, you can explore one of the halls alone.
cues.zh: 首先要了解的是 既然你知道你沒有被附身 你可以自己探索其中一條通道

cues.text: This leaves eight students for the remaining three paths.
cues.en: This leaves eight students for the remaining three paths.
cues.zh: 你可以自己探索其中一條通道 剩下的三條交給八位學生

cues.text: Sending groups of four down just two of the paths won't work
cues.en: Sending groups of four down just two of the paths won't work
cues.zh: 各派出 4人組 （4-4） 去探索兩條通道是行不通的 因為如果一組回來後 分成 2 對 2 各說各話

cues.text: because if one group came back split two versus two,
cues.en: because if one group came back split two versus two,
cues.zh: 因為如果一組回來後 分成 2 對 2 各說各話 你必須去猜測要相信誰

cues.text: you'd have to guess who to trust.
cues.en: you'd have to guess who to trust.
cues.zh: 因為如果一組回來後 分成 2 對 2 各說各話 你必須去猜測要相信誰

cues.text: But splitting them into one pair and two trios would work every time,
cues.en: But splitting them into one pair and two trios would work every time,
cues.zh: 但分成一個兩人組、兩個三人組 每次都可行 接著說明理由

cues.text: and here's why.
cues.en: and here's why.
cues.zh: 接著說明理由 被附身的學生可能說謊，也可能不會

cues.text: The possessed students might lie, or they might not,
cues.en: The possessed students might lie, or they might not,
cues.zh: 被附身的學生可能說謊，也可能不會 但你知道這僅是其中的兩位

cues.text: but you know there are only two of them, while the other six will always tell the truth.
cues.en: but you know there are only two of them, while the other six will always tell the truth.
cues.zh: 被附身的學生可能說謊，也可能不會 但你知道這僅是其中的兩位 而另外六位一直都說實話

cues.text: When each group returns to the hall, all of its members will either give the same report
cues.en: When each group returns to the hall, all of its members will either give the same report
cues.zh: 而另外六位一直都說實話 當各組都回到大廳時 隊員不是回報相同的內容

cues.text: or argue about whether they found the exit.
cues.en: or argue about whether they found the exit.
cues.zh: 隊員不是回報相同的內容 就是在爭論他們是否找到出口

cues.text: If a trio returns in total agreement, then you know none of them are lying.
cues.en: If a trio returns in total agreement, then you know none of them are lying.
cues.zh: 如果三人組帶回一致的內容 便知道他們都沒有說謊 至於兩人組，無論意見一致否， 都無法確認

cues.text: With the pair, you can't be sure either way, but all you need is reliable evidence about three of the four paths.
cues.en: With the pair, you can't be sure either way, but all you need is reliable evidence about three of the four paths.
cues.zh: 便知道他們都沒有說謊 至於兩人組，無論意見一致否， 都無法確認 但你需要只是四條中的三條 有可靠的証據

cues.text: The fourth you can figure out using the process of elimination.
cues.en: The fourth you can figure out using the process of elimination.
cues.zh: 但你需要只是四條中的三條 有可靠的証據 第四條用「刪去法」就可找到答案

cues.text: Of course, none of this matters if you're lucky enough to find the exit yourself,
cues.en: Of course, none of this matters if you're lucky enough to find the exit yourself,
cues.zh: 第四條用「刪去法」就可找到答案 當然，這些都是紙上談兵── 只要你夠幸運自己找到出口

cues.text: but otherwise, putting everything together leaves you with three possibilities.
cues.en: but otherwise, putting everything together leaves you with three possibilities.
cues.zh: 否則彙整所有資訊後， 就只有三種可能性 一：如果各組的回應都一致

cues.text: If each group gives a consistent answer, either everyone is telling the truth,
cues.en: If each group gives a consistent answer, either everyone is telling the truth,
cues.zh: 一：如果各組的回應都一致 則可能是每個人都說實話 或是被附身的兩位學生在同組

cues.text: or the two possessed students are paired together.
cues.en: or the two possessed students are paired together.
cues.zh: 或是被附身的兩位學生在同組 無論哪一種，忽略兩人組

cues.text: In either case, ignore the duo.
cues.en: In either case, ignore the duo.
cues.zh: 無論哪一種，忽略兩人組 二：如果只有一組在爭執， 則其餘兩組都說了實話

cues.text: If there's only one group arguing, both others must be telling the truth,
cues.en: If there's only one group arguing, both others must be telling the truth,
cues.zh: 無論哪一種，忽略兩人組 二：如果只有一組在爭執， 則其餘兩組都說了實話

cues.text: and if there are two conflicts, then the possessed students are in separate groups
cues.en: and if there are two conflicts, then the possessed students are in separate groups
cues.zh: 二：如果只有一組在爭執， 則其餘兩組都說了實話 三：如果有兩組在爭執，可知 被附身的學生 是各分在不同的兩組裡

cues.text: and you can safely trust the majority in both trios
cues.en: and you can safely trust the majority in both trios
cues.zh: 被附身的學生 是各分在不同的兩組裡 你可安心地採信 三人組中多數人的答案

cues.text: since at least two people in each will be truthful.
cues.en: since at least two people in each will be truthful.
cues.zh: 因為各組至少有兩個人是可信的 神殿在你們身後崩塌

cues.text: The temple collapses behind you as greenish vapors escape from two of the students.
cues.en: The temple collapses behind you as greenish vapors escape from two of the students.
cues.zh: 因為各組至少有兩個人是可信的 神殿在你們身後崩塌 綠色煙霧從兩位學生身上竄出

cues.text: You're all safe and free from the curse.
cues.en: You're all safe and free from the curse.
cues.zh: 你們全都安全了，也擺脫了詛咒 經歷了這次的考驗

cues.text: After that ordeal, you tell your group they all deserve a vacation,
cues.en: After that ordeal, you tell your group they all deserve a vacation,
cues.zh: 經歷了這次的考驗 你告訴你的團隊， 他們都應該好好放個假 而你也剛好想到了另一個探險之旅

cues.text: and you just happen to have another expedition coming up.
cues.en: and you just happen to have another expedition coming up.
cues.zh: 你告訴你的團隊， 他們都應該好好放個假 而你也剛好想到了另一個探險之旅
